steps.text: Hui-chieh:
From where I left off.
I ran for a very long time. Ran into a small village.
I didn't think too much about it at the time. I only wanted to find somewhere to hide. I didn't think I'd actually find somewhere to stay.
And I think that old couple thought of me as a daughter. Since their own sons and daughters had probably long since lost their lives to Ursus's countless wars.
They even kept my secret for me.
I'm sure I could've spent a lifetime repaying their kindness.
I regret that I never did.
January 13th

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: During our previous routine inspection, one of our people was assaulted.

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: Every household must now submit to a search, both for Infected and the attacker. Should we find them, we will execute them on the spot, and the household that harbored them will be punished accordingly.

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: If you don't want a hard labor sentence, turn them in. No one will come to harm if you do your civic duty, and the offenders and Infected will meet their proper end.

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: Now, we'll start from the first household.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It looks like the day came after all. There's no chance I'll make it through this one.

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: Don't go out there, Talulah! Hide behind the shed... they won't look there! We'll tell them you were scared of what was coming and ran away! No one'd blame you for it!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: But they might hurt you for it. I owe you better than that.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I've left you some gold coins... from Victoria. Spend them sparingly, and they'll have you warm and well fed for the rest of your lives.

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: Talulah, Talulah! Where are you going? My Talulah... you can't, you can't go to them! Those black-hearted patrolling bugs eat people alive!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: And I can't just stand by and let them torture the men and women of this village. I have to see this through. I'll lure them away, give them a wake-up call, let them know what they've wrought.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I know what's right. I'm not letting them punish these people. I'm not letting them murder anyone else.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I still remember how the boy next door was beaten to death for chucking a stone. I'll never forget.

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: Talulah... Talulah! You can't... that's enough!

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: Who?! Who's at the door...!? Is it the patrolmen?! Go away!

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Ma'am, it's me!

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: Alina! Come in, come in!

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: What's wrong? What's happened? Is there news?

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: ...Someone told.

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: What? Told what?

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: The Patrol Unit knows there's an Infected in our village.

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: How could... this can't be... ahh!

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: I don't know who it was, but we all know what happens to those who harbor Infected.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Ma'am, my father passed early, and you took such good care of my mother, you and your husband both. You're like grandparents to me.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: And at this point, I can't really hide anything...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: —Wait.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Miss, where did the Mister go?

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: Bloody old fart, what are you doing here?

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: I committed a crime!

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: A confession? Ah, yeah, I remember.  An old geezer got in our guy's way. Judging by your limp, you were one of the thugs who attacked him!

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Yup!

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: ...Not that you look worth the trouble. Go take a bloody hike. No point in dirtying our hands over a miserable little wretch.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Hold it. Sir, look at my skin here. What's that look like to you?

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: Infected! You're the Infected?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Are you serious?!

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: I realized the moment I helped you change clothes... Talulah, we've known you were Infected for a long time now.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: How—

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: The old man worked the mines, and came back after he'd caught Oripathy himself! You've seen how he never takes off that jacket of his...

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: He's going to go in your place, Talulah...!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: But how could he have been...

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: You can't trust the people here like that! The villagers will say whatever they need to, for money or to save their own skins!

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: For the last two years, Talulah, we've been truly happy to have you! You're a good girl... a good girl!

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: We don't have long left to live, but Talulah, even if you're ill, you've still got years yet! You need to live, Talulah, that's what's right...

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: Talulah, don't go! For heaven's sakes, don't go...!

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Take me.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Take me then, officer!

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Look at my skin! I'm the bloody diseased one!

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: If you don't believe me, then take a look at this!

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: A knife? Put that down. You can't touch us, old man.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: No, officer, watch my Arts!
The elderly man slices open his own wrist, but no red flows onto the snow. It is instead as mist, scattering into the air.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Look, look... Officer! I'm an Infected, tried and true!

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: I believe you.

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: Thank you for your cooperation, Infected.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Nnf... nnf...!

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Talulah...

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Talulah! Come back! Don't!

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Is that... fire?

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: What?! Why is the house on—

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Talulah! Did you—

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Don't! Talulah! They'll destroy the whole village!
